method: Collected every selected node and recorded its function origin, parameters, fixtures and marks.
Parsed every selected test file: imports, call expressions, assertions, duplicate definitions/bodies, repeated parameter values and unused parameter arguments.
Traced local module imports from backend.api.main and inspected non-app dependencies, lifecycle notes, private function callers, string dispatch and test/reference consumers before pruning.
Identical bodies across distinct fixture/backend contexts were retained. Same setup with different assertions was not treated as duplicate behavior.

Ran the full fast suite before and after; the CSV attaches final test outcomes. This is a static dependency and redundancy audit plus runtime validation, not per-test production coverage or a formal proof of semantic uniqueness.

retained_examples.BLADE: Hidden UI tab, but routes_blade is registered in main.py and routes_md still supports BLADE seeds.
retained_examples.propagator_shared_utilities: systems, local_run and windows still support experiment scripts; only shelved baseline/scaling reference tests were archived.
retained_examples.native_connection_matrices: Distinct connection families, direct replacement, organization transport, disconnect, persistence, replay and HTTP ownership behavior.
retained_examples.string_dispatched_functions: md_frames_atomistic and _build_nick_batch are selected by string registries despite lacking direct call expressions.
retained_examples.reference_oracles: Legacy PDB assembly, native binary unpackers and numerical reference helpers independently check optimized/current outputs.
retained_examples.same_setup: 66 groups found, mostly different assertions or inputs; retained except registration-only checks consolidated without dropping endpoint assertions.

limitations: Static imports/call names are dependency evidence, not proof that every assertion reaches a user-facing feature.
Compatibility, numerical reference and isolated experiment checks can be useful without a direct application caller; uncertain candidates were retained.
No performance-driven demotion or guard/threshold changes. The aggregate fast-suite runtime remains well above the 90-second warning threshold.

rejected_validation_attempt.reason: Audit-selected basetemp created 143-byte Unix socket paths, exceeding AF_UNIX length limit; two unchanged Alpine worker tests could not start their sockets. Direct bind reproduced AF_UNIX path too long. Rerun with short /tmp scratch paths.

inherited_scratch_attempt.reason: Four pytest subprocess self-tests inherited the audit basetemp override, which points to an ancestor of their working directory. Pytest correctly refused that unsafe configuration before collecting. Remove the override; retain and explicitly review the resulting gate incidents.

default_scratch_confirmation.note: Tests passed; command remained blocked by the preserved incidents until the explicit reviews above. Gate check passed after review.

validation.lint: Ruff and git diff --check passed for changed files.
